coverage: Two reported business groups · group totals
incomeDefinition: Each row includes sales to other parts of the group. The company removes those internal sales when it reports group revenue from operations. Reported revenue also includes government incentive income.
definition: The reported profit for each business before group financing costs, income and expenses not assigned to a business, unusual items and tax.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment revenue before removing internal sales
sourceLabel: Audited full-year results filed by Deepak Nitrite
location: PDF pages 2–3, audited consolidated year-ended column, and page 6, notes 3 and 4.
notes: After removing ₹66.93 crore of internal sales, group revenue from operations was ₹7,887.07 crore. It includes ₹102.10 crore in government incentive income. Group profit after tax was ₹550.66 crore, including a ₹12.84 crore pre-tax charge for estimated employee benefit obligations under new labour rules. Profit attributable to owners of the parent company was ₹550.53 crore.
insight: Phenolics brought in more revenue and contributed more before interest, tax and other group adjustments. The segment row covers several products together.
